constraints: Nominal fixed 2D polygons and 500 mm circular person, with a half-cell-diagonal margin. Entry starts 600 mm inside the opening. Door hinges are inferred. Seat and occupation proxies are static, not a human posture or chair motion simulation. The full-front 300 mm projection is a broad sensitivity reserve, not the mechanism or dimensions of a selected storage product. Desk length reduced by 100 mm. Site, skirting, chair, window sash and actual wardrobe/storage leaves remain to be measured.
